name: Atlas Finetuning with Sparse Adam
definition: A post-baking optimization step where the baked atlas is treated as an initialization and optimized against training images to recover quality lost during baking (quantization, pruning). Only texel colors are trained; geometry and view-dependent color are frozen.
summary: Atlas Finetuning with Sparse Adam recovers post-baking quality by optimizing only atlas texels with a sparse optimizer, eliminating hash collisions and exceeding teacher performance.
